- Put the plain unit or noun right after the number (metres, dollars, people, bolts, sweets, litres, kilometres, square metres).
- No working: no arithmetic, no equals sign, no operation words (times, divided, plus, minus, product, sum, each, per, total, area, percent, shared), no intermediate numbers.
- Do not hedge (no "about", "roughly", "around", "not").
- Keep the sentence under 40 words and make sure it is complete.

Use this same calm style for every problem.
